sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new family of models, including Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8 -Max. Qwen3.8 has vision and thinking capabilities and a 256K context window (up to 1M tokens). Qwen3.8-27B, the upcoming 27B parameter model will be released this Friday and Unsloth will have day-zero support. Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a 2.4T parameter open-weight model (95B active) that rivals GPT-5.6 Sol.
